description: This file is a PHP template used for rendering blog post pages and summaries, including handling galleries, media, tags, and author information.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Model class representing a blog post, providing methods like getById to retrieve posts by ID.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Library class providing static methods for text processing, such as recorta and get.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Model class representing an image, providing methods like getLink to obtain image URLs.

methods.name: Post::getById
methods.description: Fetches a blog post object by its ID and language.

methods.name: Text::recorta
methods.description: Shortens a given text to a specified length, primarily used for summaries.

methods.name: Text::get
methods.description: Retrieves localized text strings for UI labels.

methods.name: Image->getLink
methods.description: Generates a URL for the image with specified dimensions.

methods.name: media->getEmbedCode
methods.description: Returns HTML embed code for media objects like videos.
